## Day 1 in-class assignment: Introduction to R

Covers lecture note 01, and how to control what a code chunk shows in Quarto.

1. Download [Assignment-1.qmd](Assignment-1/Assignment-1.qmd){download="Assignment-1.qmd"} and open it in RStudio.
2. Write your answers in that file, then render it.
3. Hand in the `.qmd` and the rendered `.html` at the end of class.
